sources.title: Florence-2-large: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Florence-2-large is a vision foundation model developed by microsoft that performs multiple vision and vision-language tasks through a prompt-based interface. The model contains 0.77 billion parameters and uses a sequence-to-sequence architecture trained on the FLD-5B dataset, which contains 5.4 billion annotations across 126 million images.
